result.title: Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models
result.summary: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 THAW，在视频扩散采样的初始去噪窗口内，对 CFG 预测差中均值分量之外的部分施加单独加权的残差，以在不改变网络评估次数、无需训练的前提下增强生成动作幅度。
